rule: Each agent writes one kind of document. No agent rewrites another's.

roles.title: Permanent Representative
roles.function: Head of Mission. Takes the decision on every full file.

roles.title: Deputy Permanent Representative
roles.function: Chief operating officer: triages every meeting, assigns counsellors, reviews their work, writes notes and the options memo.
follows: Organisational plenary items (elections, appointments, UN reform)

roles.title: Political Counsellor
roles.function: Peace and security, humanitarian affairs and human rights.
follows: Political, humanitarian and human-rights plenary items

roles.title: Legal Counsellor
follows: Legal plenary items (ICJ and ICC reports, law of the sea)

roles.title: Economic & Environment Counsellor
roles.function: Development, environment, climate change, and the UN budget and administration.
follows: Development, climate and budget plenary items

roles.title: Press Counsellor
roles.function: Statement, explanation of vote or press note.
follows: Works only when the decision asks for it or the DPR flags the file as high-profile

plenary_rule: Plenary meetings go to a counsellor by subject, chosen by the DPR at triage (dpr for organisational items).
assignment_rules: A legal opinion is mandatory on every Security Council full file that involves the use of force, sanctions or the Charter.
Every full file carries at least one opinion from a counsellor other than the lead.
The DPR may add a second counsellor for a cross-cutting file.
capital: Out of scope. No document refers to instructions from Capital.
